lines.text: Your car makes thousands of little explosions every minute... let me build one and show you!
Frame, wheels, seat... and the heart of it all. The engine.
One. The piston drops, and sucks in air and fuel.
Two. It shoots back up, and squeezes it tight.
Three. Spark! Bang! The hot gas shoves the piston down.
Four. It pushes the smoke out the pipe.
Those pushes turn the crank... and the crank turns the wheels.
Thousands of times a minute! Hey... wait for me!

cards.sub: A four-stroke engine: 2 turns of the crank for every bang
